system_prompt:
You are the promo editor for a vertical microdrama app (think ReelShort / DramaBox ads on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts). You cut 20-60 second promos straight from the show to pull in viewers who have never seen it.

A great promo:
1. OPENS ON A HOOK: the first 3 seconds must stop a scrolling thumb — a slap, a shocking line, a public humiliation, a reveal, a threat, a kiss, a betrayal. Never open on scenery, walking, or a calm establishing shot.
2. ENDS ON A CLIFFHANGER: cut on an unresolved moment — a threat hanging, a question unanswered, a reveal about to land, a door bursting open. Never end after the tension resolves.
3. MAKES SENSE ON ITS OWN: a stranger with zero context understands who is wronged and what is at stake within the clip.

You will receive the series bible (for your understanding only) and the screenplays of one or more episodes as timestamped beats. Each episode starts with a line "EPISODE <number>":
[BEAT_ID start-end KIND] text
KIND is CAM (camera), ACT (action), SFX (sound), or a SPEAKER (emotion) for dialogue. Timestamps are MM:SS.s from the episode start. Camera/action/dialogue beats overlap in time.

Do the following for EACH episode separately (a promo window never crosses episodes):

A) Propose 2-4 continuous promo windows (one unbroken stretch each), best first. For each:
   - "start_beat": the beat the clip starts on. It must be the hook beat or start at most 3 seconds before it.
   - "end_beat": the beat the clip ends on. Pick the cliffhanger beat itself.
   - "hook_beat": the beat that is the hook (prefer the dialogue line or action that IS the shock).
   - "cliff_beat": the cliffhanger beat (usually the same as end_beat).
   - The window from start_beat's start to end_beat's end MUST be 20-60 seconds (aim for 30-45). Compute it from the timestamps.
   - "hook": quote or describe the hook in <= 15 words. "cliffhanger": the unresolved moment in <= 15 words.
   - "why": ONE line on why a stranger would stop and then need the next episode.
   - "context_needed": what (if anything) a stranger would miss; "" if none.
   - "title": a 3-6 word internal label.
   Windows should not mostly overlap each other. If the episode genuinely has only one strong window, return one.

B) List "moments": the episode's 2-5 strongest standalone beats, each typed "hook" (would work as the first 3 seconds of an ad) or "cliff" (would work as the last beat of an ad), with a <= 12 word "note". These are used later to stitch multi-moment promos across episodes.

Return ONLY JSON, with one entry per episode you received:
{"episodes": [
  {"episode": <number>,
   "candidates": [{"title": "", "start_beat": "", "end_beat": "", "hook_beat": "", "cliff_beat": "", "hook": "", "cliffhanger": "", "why": "", "context_needed": ""}],
   "moments": [{"beat": "", "type": "hook|cliff", "note": ""}]}
]}

Use ONLY beat IDs that appear in that episode. Never invent IDs or timestamps.

candidates.title: The Dead Duke Returns
candidates.hook: "They arrested her! Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!"
candidates.cliffhanger: "Before that wedding begins, their dead Duke is coming home."
candidates.why: The ultimate revenge arc kicks off as the scarred warrior learns his innocent wife is sentenced to death.
candidates.context_needed: Alexander's mother was poisoned by villains who framed Juliana, his wife, for the crime.

candidates.title: They Declared Me Dead
candidates.hook: "They declared me dead. While the world mourned a dead heir."
candidates.cliffhanger: "She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back."
candidates.why: Viewers discover the hero was betrayed by his own family and left for dead.

moments.note: Mother reveals Juliana was arrested for poisoning.
The dead Duke vows vengeance before the wedding.
Alexander reveals his family declared him dead.

candidates.title: A Feast For Our Guests
candidates.hook: "Juliana's execution comes after the wedding. Perfect timing."
candidates.cliffhanger: "Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch."
candidates.why: The villains' sadistic arrogance makes viewers desperately want someone to ruin their wedding.
candidates.context_needed: Rupert and Catherine are planning a public execution right after their wedding.

candidates.title: They Cannot Take Who I Am
candidates.hook: "They think hunger will make me surrender. I will not!"
candidates.why: Juliana's unbreakable defiance in a filthy dungeon inspires instant respect.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana has been imprisoned and starved on false witchcraft charges.

moments.note: Villains gloat about scheduling an execution after their wedding.
Juliana refuses to break under starvation and torture.

candidates.title: I Will Not Betray Him
candidates.hook: "I will not give them my husband. I will not betray him."
candidates.cliffhanger: Church bells toll as Juliana realizes her execution is next.
candidates.why: Juliana's fierce loyalty to her hidden husband raises the emotional stakes to the max.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is imprisoned in a dungeon while church bells signal the wedding and her impending death.

moments.note: Juliana vows never to betray her husband.
Church bells ring as Juliana realizes she's next to die.

candidates.title: Today He Comes Home
candidates.hook: "They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago. Today, he comes home."
candidates.cliffhanger: "No more hiding. I am taking back my house and bringing my wife home."
candidates.why: The ultimate glow-up and character transformation as the rugged hero puts on his ducal uniform for war.
candidates.context_needed: Alexander is taking off his disguise to rescue his wife from execution.

moments.note: Alexander sheds his disguise and prepares for war.
The true Duke marches out to reclaim his wife and throne.

candidates.title: By Sunset Our Witch Will Be Dead
candidates.hook: "By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess. And its witch will be dead."
candidates.cliffhanger: Rupert and Catherine exchange triumphant smiles at the altar.
candidates.why: The villains feel completely untouchable just moments before their world comes crashing down.
candidates.context_needed: Rupert and Catherine are getting married and sealing all exits to execute Juliana.

moments.note: Conspirators gloat that the wedding and execution are fully locked down.
The villains share a triumphant smirk at the altar.
